title: Oro Application Update Manifest Signature
description: Schema for manifest.sig files used to sign Oro Application Update manifests.

schemaVersion.description: Signature schema version. Gates breaking changes to the signature layout.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm used for the manifest signature.

keyId.description: Identifier for the signing key, used by clients to select the correct public key.

signature.description: Encoded detached signature over the raw manifest bytes (hex or base64url).
